register.labelZh: SPIN 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: spin around 和 spin round 可以描述某人聽到聲音或注意到某事後迅速轉身,也可以表示使椅子、螢幕或其他物件迅速轉向。；spin off 可以表示書籍、遊戲、月曆、Podcast 或電視節目由原有作品衍生出來。；當公司的一部分成為獨立業務時,常可使用 spin something off。；spin something out 可以表示刻意延長演講、會議、用餐、故事或答案。
register.summaryEn: Spin around and spin round can describe a person turning quickly after hearing a sound or noticing something. They can also describe making a chair, screen or other object face another direction. Spin off can show that a book, game, calendar, podcast or television programme was developed from something that already existed. Spin something off is often used when part of a company becomes an independent business. Spin something out can describe making a talk, meeting, meal, story or answer continue longer than usual or necessary.
